sources.note: Homepage. Cloud-based EHR & billing for rural hospitals and ambulatory clinics. Highlights AI Clinical Assistant, AI Billing Assistant, Analytics. Testimonials from Reeves Memorial Medical Center and Gabbert Medical.
Lists two certified products: ChartAccess 7.0 (CHPL 11140, hospital EHR) and Azalea EHR 4.0 (CHPL 11151, ambulatory). Includes links to cost disclosures, real world testing, and MFA documentation.

Hospital EHR product page. Built for critical access hospitals under 100 beds. One patient record across inpatient, ED, and clinics. Integrated clinical and financial workflows. Screenshots show lab results, patient allergies, patient records.
Ambulatory EHR product page. 37% faster than competing EHRs. Includes practice management, patient portal, HIE connectivity, billing. Mentions 30% charting reduction, 25% faster registration.
Ambulatory EHR overview. Practice management, cloud-based EHR, end-to-end RCM services. Claims speed improvement noted.

Detailed patient engagement features: myHealthspot patient portal (allergies, meds, labs, bill pay, secure messaging, appointment requests), MyPractice provider mobile app (charge capture, ICD/CPT codes, face sheets), Patient Kiosk (iPad check-in, English/Spanish), integrated telehealth.

RCM services page. Outsourced billing with certified billers. Claim scrubbing, denials/appeals, AR management, patient collections. 37 days avg A/R. Includes EHR, telehealth, and Analytics at no extra cost for RCM clients.

Azalea Analytics: Enterprise Data Warehouse, KPI/CQM dashboards, MIPS/MACRA reporting, population health, patient risk stratification, gaps in care. Integrates with legacy EHRs (Athena, eCW, NextGen, etc.).

AzaleaConnect HIE: connection to national HIE for querying external patient records. Saves 10-15 min per patient. Access to visit details, test results, medication lists, allergies from external providers.
AI features: Clinical Assistant powered by Suki for ambient charting and voice-enabled transcription. Billing Assistant for coding error detection, claim status tracking, denial prevention.
Solutions overview. Mentions AzaleaONE patient health index for interoperability. Platform connects hospitals to clinics.

Capterra listing (403 blocked, but search results indicate 4.2/5 stars from 88 reviews). Users praise ease of use and customer support. Some complaints about limited customization and occasional glitches.
G2 listing (403 blocked, but search results indicate 3.9/5 stars). Praised for efficiency in rural/small practice settings. Some complaints about glitches and update cycles.
Software Advice listing (referenced in search). 4.1-4.2/5 stars. Generally positive for cost-conscious providers.
